description: AI-BOM License Chain Resolver for Hugging Face Models — Walks the Hugging Face lineage of up to 10 models (base_model chain, training datasets; at most 30 nodes, 4 generations) and applies a curated, hash-pinned table of license clauses (Apache-2.0, MIT, CC-BY, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-SA, OpenRAIL variants, Llama 2 / 3 / 3.1 / 3.2 / 3.3, Gemma, Mistral Research License) to each intended use: commercial or not, API, weights or on-prem, fine-tuning, monthly acti

dataset_terms.description: advisory (default): a dataset license restriction yields UNDETERMINED because it is unsettled whether it binds trained weights. binding: treat it as binding and report CONFLICT.

datasets.description: Extra Hugging Face dataset repo ids; datasets named on the model cards are followed automatically.

models.description: Hugging Face model repo ids (owner/name) used together in the system.

uses.description: Intended uses to decide, each evaluated independently.

commercial.description: Any commercial activity, revenue, or business operations connected to the use.

distribution.description: api: hosted service, weights stay with you. weights: you redistribute model weights. on_prem: internal use only.

fields_of_use.description: Sensitive fields the use touches; checked against field-of-use clauses.

fine_tune.description: You will fine-tune, merge, quantize or otherwise modify the models. Default false.

id.description: Label echoed in the result; defaults to use-1, use-2, ...

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the licensee's domicile or principal place of business, e.g. DE. Required for regional clauses.

monthly_active_users.description: Monthly active users of your products and affiliates; compared with user-count thresholds such as Llama's 700 million. Required to evaluate those clauses.

trains_other_models.description: Outputs of these models will train or improve a different model that is not a derivative of the same family (distillation). Default false.

name: ai-bom-license-resolver
